question: The percentage profit earned by selling an article for Rs. 955 is equal to the percentage loss incurred by selling the same article for Rs. 845. At what price should the article be sold to make a 6% profit?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If Profit % at SP₁ = Loss % at SP₂, then CP = (SP₁ + SP₂) ÷ 2

CP = (955 + 845) ÷ 2 = 1800 ÷ 2 = Rs. 900

To gain 6% profit, SP = CP × (100 + Profit %)/100

SP = 900 × 1.06 = Rs. 954

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 954.**
